hotspots.name: The Ladder Of Light
hotspots.description: It goes down into the depth of the grey fog, which is a direction the fog did not have until you were high enough to be told about it.

hotspots.name: The Bronze Table
hotspots.description: Twenty-two seats. Rather more of them are occupied these days, and the ones that are not have begun to feel like an appointment rather than an absence.

hotspots.name: A Window Onto Backlund
hotspots.description: The smog over the city has stopped behaving like weather. Somewhere under it, a mausoleum is being opened by people who have each decided they are the only one being careful.

hotspots.name: The Circle
hotspots.description: The castle does not need chalk. It simply understands what you are about to do and makes room.

exits.label: The Forsaken Land of the Gods
